Character Gallery Appearances Eugene [ 5 ] Harold [ 6 ] [ 7 ] Krabs [ 8 ] (born November 30 , 1942 [ 9 ] [ 1 ] or September 25 , 1960 [ 10 ] ), more commonly known as Mr. Krabs , is one of the ten main characters in the SpongeBob SquarePants franchise. [ 11 ] He is a miserly red crab who lives in an anchor with his daughter, Pearl , who is a teenage whale . He is the owner and founder of the Krusty Krab restaurant as well as the employer of both SpongeBob and Squidward . Mr. Krabs was designed by Stephen Hillenburg , a marine biology teacher. Hillenburg often received fan letters asking why Pearl is a whale while her father is a crab. [ 12 ] Hillenburg simply wanted each member of the main cast to be a different animal. For other articles with the same name, see Ursula (disambiguation) . “ I admit that in the past I've been a nasty... they weren't kidding when they called me, well, a witch ” ―Ursula during her song Poor Unfortunate Souls [src] Ursula is the main antagonist of Disney 's 1989 animated feature film The Little Mermaid . She is a villainous sea witch who strikes deals with poor unfortunate merfolk with the promise of making their dreams come true. Ursula's contracts, however, are covertly designed to advance her own ambitions and cause general misery. In the past, Ursula was a resident of King Triton 's palace, before being banished and exiled by order of the king. itens.trecho: “ Mufasa : Don't turn your back on me, Scar! Scar: Oh, no, Mufasa. Perhaps you shouldn't turn your back on me. ” ―Scar and Mufasa [src] Scar is the main antagonist of Disney 's 1994 animated feature film The Lion King . As the younger and envious brother of Mufasa and second-born Prince of the Pride Lands , Scar was next in line to assume the throne as king. His line in succession was replaced, however, upon the birth of his nephew, Simba . This embittered Scar with jealousy and a sense of entitlement, prompting him to develop a regicidal plot to take over the kingdom, with the aid of his hyena minions . As one of Disney's most infamous villains, made especially notorious for his success in murdering Mufasa, Scar is a primary member of the Disney Villains franchise. itens.trecho: O Mauricio [ 7 ] Hiromashi , [ 8 ] mais conhecido como Do Contra , [ 9 ] [ 10 ] é mais um dos excêntricos personagens da Turma da Mônica . Com uma pitada de contradição que o diferencia dos demais, o quê para ele é ótimo, ele gosta de ser diferentão . Ganhou seu espaço nas revistinhas com sua veia fortíssima de rebeldia. É comum para ele contrariar o "normal", o "comum", e quer sempre experimentar o diferente sem medo das consequências. É irmão mais novo do Nimbus , um ilusionista, fruto do relacionamento da Keiko e do Nimbão (sendo a sua mãe de ascendência japonesa , o que o torna um sansei), que sempre se atrapalham pela personalidade diferente e excepcional do filho. Ele já se mostrou interessado pela Mônica . ↑ Revista Parque da Mônica Nº 68 ( Ed. itens.trecho: Daffy Duck is an anthropomorphic duck appearing in the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series of cartoon shorts, where he is usually depicted as a rival and occasional best friend of Bugs Bunny . Daffy was one of the first of the new "screwball" characters that emerged in the late 1930s to replace traditional "everyman" characters who were more popular earlier in the decade, such as Mickey Mouse and Popeye. Daffy starred in 130 shorts in the Golden Age of Animation, only behind Bugs Bunny's 168 appearances and Porky Pig 's 153 appearances. Daffy was ranked #14 on TV Guide's list of Top 50 Best cartoon characters and was featured on one of the issue's four covers with Porky Pig , both of which are Warner Bros. Discovery -owned characters. ↑ https://twitter.com/bauzilla/status/1024024182458277889

itens.trecho: Lisa Marie Simpson (born May 9 or April 2 [ 15 ] ) is a charismatic 8-year-old girl who exceeds the standard achievement level of children her age. Not to everyone's surprise, she is also the moral centre of her family . In her upbringing, Lisa lacks parental involvement from Homer and Marge , which leads to hobbies such as playing saxophone and guitar, riding and caring for horses, and an interest in advanced studies. In school, Lisa's popularity is affected by those who view her as a geeky overachiever, which leaves her with only a few friends. Lisa Simpson is a smart, witty, independent girl who focuses on her goals and strives to reach her potential, and at age 8, she is already a member of MENSA with an IQ of 159.
